[CAPTURE] the rendered text of the first section as V1
--- SCREEN: Designer ---
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/apps/site-builder-shell/?storeId=@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)#/site-builder-active
[ACT] open the page
[WAIT] the UI settles (no spinner, network idle)
[ACT] click 'Edit in designer'
[WAIT] the UI settles (no spinner, network idle)
[ACT] edit the text of the first section
[WAIT] the UI settles (no spinner, network idle)

[CONSOLE] no uncaught exception in the designer

Title: Theme publish — themeSnapshot returns the new publication right after Publish theme
Preconditions:
Module VirtoCommerce.SiteBuilder installed (3.1000.0-pr-1-28d0 or later); back office signed in as the ADMIN test account (password typed by its NAME ADMIN_PASSWORD).
Shared-state window: no other session writes the B2B-store theme drafts or publications meanwhile (theme publications are append-only; the designer cannot delete a published template).
Store B2B-store already has a theme publication (a themeSnapshot read of a store with none creates publication 1 — never do that on a shared store). Capture LAST_GOOD = current publication number before starting.
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token as the ADMIN test account (password NAME ADMIN_PASSWORD, never a literal)
[AUTH] keep the bearer token
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/site-builder/theme/status?storeId=@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)
[CAPTURE] publication as P0
[GQL] query themeSnapshot(storeId: "@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)", cultureName: "en-US")
[CAPTURE] publication number as S0
[SETUP] save one valid header draft through the designer (header announcement text AGENT-TEST-SB003-<unique>)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/site-builder/theme/publish for the store with the current catalogHash (the hash in default/catalogs/current.json: GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/content/themes/<store_id>?relativeUrl=default/catalogs/current.json, the storage key the save and the publish accept; the `hash` field of GET /api/site-builder/catalog is the storefront's own and is refused with 'no schema catalog')
[CAPTURE] publication in the 200 body as P1
[GQL] repeat the themeSnapshot query immediately
[CAPTURE] publication as S1
Assertions:
[REL] P0 equals S0 before the publish (status and snapshot agree) {OBSERVED} (docs/contracts/theme-snapshot.md; vcst, 2026-11-19, REG-2026-11-19-2029)
[REL] P1 equals P0 + 1 and S1 equals P1 on the very next anonymous read {OBSERVED} (docs/contracts/theme-snapshot.md: the pointer is written last and the storefront sees the new theme at once; vcst, 2026-11-19, REG-2026-11-19-2029)
[REL] S1 was served without waiting for a cache TTL (read issued right after the 200) {OBSERVED} (KB-7D908FAE: 168 ms after the 200, vcst, 2026-11-19)
[ERRORS] errors[] empty in both themeSnapshot responses {OBSERVED} (docs/contracts/theme-snapshot.md; vcst, 2026-11-19, REG-2026-11-19-2029)
Failure_Signals: snapshot still serves P0 after the 200, publication number not +1, errors[] non-empty
Cleanup: Publications are append-only: re-publish the last good theme (discard nothing else) so the live theme equals LAST_GOOD content; record the new publication number in the run notes.
References: VCST-6571 · checklist A3 · Technique:ST Archetype:STALE | Synced: VCST-6963 (2026-11-26) | Promoted: REG-2026-11-26-1707 (2026-11-26)
